description: This file contains utility functions for managing models and deployments within the litellm project. It handles hashing credentials, mapping model IDs to file IDs, filtering models based on team ownership, and filtering deployments based on web search support. The code relies on specific project types and external modules related to litellm's internal structure.

methods.name: str get_litellm_params_sensitive_credential_hash(litellm_params: dict)
methods.description: Generates a SHA-256 hash of the sensitive credential parameters, used for securely mapping credentials to models.

methods.name: dict add_model_file_id_mappings( healthy_deployments: Union[List[Dict], Dict], responses: List["OpenAIFileObject"] )
methods.description: Creates a mapping between model identifiers and file IDs from deployment response data.

methods.name: Union[List[Dict],Dict] filter_team_based_models( healthy_deployments: Union[List[Dict], Dict], request_kwargs: Optional[Dict] = None, )
methods.description: Filters model deployments based on team ID, ensuring only models belonging to the request's team are considered.

methods.name: bool _deployment_supports_web_search(deployment: Dict)
methods.description: Checks if a given model deployment supports web search, based on model info configuration.

methods.name: Union[List[Dict],Dict] filter_web_search_deployments( healthy_deployments: Union[List[Dict], Dict], request_kwargs: Optional[Dict] = None, )
methods.description: Filters a list of deployments to only include those supporting web search, based on request context.
